nodes.nodeTitle:
This animation modifier will adjust the volume of foley events originating from footsteps based on the speed of each foot clamped by a provided a minimum volume. It is particularly useful for any animation sequence that has a notable change in speed such as pivots, stops, and starts.

It relies on speed curves for each foot which can be generated with both the AM_FootSpeed_L and AM_FootStep_R animation modifiers.

See NotifyTracks and CurveNames variables to add support for other setups (i.e. quadrupeds).
   - NotifyTracks: Tracks that contain the fooley events for each foot.
   - CurveNames: Curves that contain the speed curves for each foot.
